prompt.zh-TW: 海風衝浪店開業三年，股本一直是 {{money:vars.capital}}，未分配盈餘則從零累積到 {{money:vars.re}}。這兩個數字的來源有什麼不同？
prompt.en: Seabreeze Surf has been open for three years. Its share capital has stayed at {{money:vars.capital}}, while unappropriated retained earnings have grown from nil to {{money:vars.re}}. How do the sources of these two figures differ?

text.zh-TW: 股本是股東投入的錢；未分配盈餘是店自己賺來、還沒分給股東的錢
text.en: Share capital is money the shareholders put in; unappropriated retained earnings are profit the shop earned and has not yet distributed

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。一個來自股東的口袋，一個來自店的經營成果。
feedback.en: Nice work. One comes from the shareholders’ pockets, the other from the shop’s own results.

short.zh-TW: 股本來自股東，未分配盈餘來自經營
short.en: Capital from shareholders, retained earnings from operations

text.zh-TW: 兩者都是股東投入的錢，未分配盈餘是股東後來追加的部分
text.en: Both are money from the shareholders; unappropriated retained earnings are what they added later

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道兩者都屬於股東權益，這點沒錯。不過股東後來追加的錢仍然記在股本（高於面額發行時，超過面額的部分記在資本公積）；未分配盈餘不是誰投入的，而是三年來一期一期的本期淨利累積出來的。
feedback.en: You know both belong to equity, which is right. But money the shareholders add later is still recorded as share capital (any premium above par goes to capital surplus); unappropriated retained earnings were not contributed by anyone. They are the profits of three years added up period by period.

short.zh-TW: 未分配盈餘是股東追加的錢

text.zh-TW: 股本是店賺來的錢，未分配盈餘是股東投入的錢
text.en: Share capital is profit the shop earned; unappropriated retained earnings are money the shareholders put in

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道兩者的來源不同，這點沒錯，只是剛好反了。股本在開業那天就有了，那時店還沒賺任何錢；會隨著經營成果長大的是未分配盈餘。
feedback.en: You know the two have different sources, which is right, but they are the other way round. Share capital existed on opening day, before the shop had earned anything; it is unappropriated retained earnings that grow with the results.

short.zh-TW: 股本是賺來的，未分配盈餘是投入的
short.en: Capital is earned, retained earnings contributed

explanation.zh-TW: 股東權益有兩個來源：{{term:tm_5e3py55a}}是股東拿出來的本錢，{{term:tm_4c6v99nn}}是公司用本錢做生意賺到、還留在公司裡的錢。股本三年不變、未分配盈餘從零長大，正好說明了{{option:o_jb2d}}。{{option:o_bwcj}}與{{option:o_7qzd}}都把兩個來源混在一起。
explanation.en: Equity has two sources: {{term:tm_5e3py55a}} is the stake the shareholders put up, and {{term:tm_4c6v99nn}} is what the company earned with that stake and has kept. Capital staying flat for three years while unappropriated retained earnings grew from nil illustrates exactly {{option:o_jb2d}}. {{option:o_bwcj}} and {{option:o_7qzd}} both mix the two sources up.
